bio_am: Ծնած է Տարօնի Վարդենիս գիւղը՝ 1858-ին։ Դաշնակցութեան առաջին գործիչներէն, կախաղան հանուեցաւ Բաղէշի մէջ՝ 1893 Յունուար 27-ին։
bio_en: Margar Amirian, known as Margar Varzhapet ('teacher'), was born in 1858 in Vardenis in Taron into a prosperous, pious family, and was inspired by the village priest's tales of Armenian heroes. Taken to the monastery of St. Karapet in 1872, he returned to Vardenis in 1879 as a teacher, and with support from Mush built the Aramian school building in 1882-84. Forced to flee to Tiflis in 1890, he returned to Taron in 1891 at the head of a small ARF band and became the link for the local revolutionaries. Arrested after the killing of a Turkish officer at Avzut in 1892, he was tortured for a year in the Bitlis prison and hanged in Bitlis on 27 January 1893.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Execution date from #116; story by S. Vratsian (Hairenik 1964).
